data.text: **Cookie authentication** stores authentication data in browser cookies. The server sets a cookie after login, and the browser sends it with each request.

1. User logs in with credentials
2. Server validates and creates session
3. Server sets cookie in response
4. Browser stores cookie
5. Browser sends cookie with each request
6. Server validates cookie

data.title: Cookie Auth
Secure Cookies
data.text: Always set HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite flags on authentication cookies to prevent XSS and CSRF attacks.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Cookies store auth data in browser
data.takeaway: Cookie auth is simple for server-rendered apps.
